narrative.overview: Just Like Any Other Week is designed as an intimate, long-scroll literary photo essay rather than a conventional web application. It treats personal memory with the quiet authority of a printed monograph, allowing the reader to experience the same narrative across three switchable visual editions: A · Sun-Bleached Editorial, B · Cinematic Darkroom, and C · Alpine Field Notes.
keyCharacteristics: Three live-switchable CSS custom-property editions sharing one centralized narrative schema (src/data/memoir.ts).
Square-cornered (0px radius) photographic plates with honest, unfabricated architectural placeholders.
Tempo-aware Motion reveals with full prefers-reduced-motion compliance.

rules.name: The Honest Plate Rule
rules.body: Photographic and video containers never display fabricated stock memories; until the author's real files exist in public/, plates render as warm tonal contact frames with technical crop lines and explicit file-path captions.

rules.name: The 66-Character Measure Rule
rules.body: Long-form memoir paragraphs are constrained to .editorial-measure (66ch) inside a centered max-w-3xl column so the eye never loses its place across 2,000 words of narrative.

rules.name: The Hairline-And-Paper Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated through paper tone steps and crisp 1px borders, never soft card drop shadows or blurred glass panels.

dos: Do keep all written narrative, captions, and file paths centralized in src/data/memoir.ts.
Do preserve 0px print-plate corners and 1px hairline dividers across all media frames.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on all scroll reveals, parallax transforms, and carousel scrolling.
donts: Don't insert fabricated personal photographs, stock people, or invented dialogue into the memoir.
Don't wrap paragraphs or photos in rounded, shadowed SaaS cards.
Don't enable autoplay with sound on any video or audio clip.
